info.title: Musebook x402m — Facilitator & Tool Shop
info.description: Production deployment of the Musebook x402 facilitator: 178 pay-per-call Solana data, trading and agent APIs, each gated in USDC on Solana mainnet (exact scheme) and settled non-custodially by the Musebook facilitator. This spec covers a representative subset; the complete priced catalog is served at GET /__x402/config on the service host.

get.summary: Fetch one hour of shop access
get.description: Grants one hour of access to the shop surface after payment. Unpaid calls return an x402 challenge priced at $0.01 in USDC on Solana mainnet.
